instruction: A greyhound curled asleep on a low rectangular plinth, carved from a single block of white Carrara marble with soft grey veining running diagonally through the flank. The ribs, spine and folded legs are rendered in smooth polished planes while the plinth face is left with rough chisel tooth marks. The muzzle rests on one forepaw.
